parsed.rationale: Both `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/HLSPlayer/Protocol/HLSAVPlayerProtocol.swift`) and `PlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RadioPlayerProtocol.swift`) live in the same `Playback` package and share three identical members: `pause:()`, `play:()`, and `rate:Float`. `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` is a specialisation that adds HLS/AV-specific capabilities (`currentTime`, `seek`, `seekableTimeRanges`, `replaceCurrentItem` is on `PlayerProtocol` only), making `PlayerProtocol` the natural base. Declaring `HLSAVPlayerProtocol: PlayerProtocol` eliminates the three redundant declarations and makes the layering explicit: any generic playback consumer can depend on `PlayerProtocol` while HLS-specific code depends on `HLSAVPlayerProtocol`. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe.
